description: List committees of the Federal Assembly (legislative committees such as WAK-N/WAK-S economy, SiK security, UREK environment, SGK health, plus supervisory committees GPK/FinK and joint bodies). Returns committee number, name, abbreviation, council (NR/SR/BV) and type. Filter by council and a name/abbreviation fragment. Examples: {council:'NR'}; {query:'Wirtschaft'}; {query:'SGK'}. Use get_committee_members for the members.

council.description: NR = National Council, SR = Council of States
